control.title: Mobile and web payment application security
control.description: Protect customer apps with device binding, detection of rooted or tampered devices and remote-access apps, obfuscation, encrypted local storage, no stored credentials, forced upgrades of old versions, server-side checks for genuine apps, and takedown of rogue apps and phishing sites.

evidence_hint: Mobile app security test report, app hardening configuration, rogue app and phishing takedown reports.
acceptance_criteria: A security test of the customer app in the last 12 months covering tampering, storage and authentication
Device binding, root or remote-access detection and version upgrade controls are switched on
Evidence of monitoring and takedown of rogue apps or phishing sites

criteria_coverage.criterion: A security test of the customer app in the last 12 months covering tampering, storage and authentication
Device binding, root or remote-access detection and version upgrade controls are switched on
Evidence of monitoring and takedown of rogue apps or phishing sites

requirements.title: MFA for debits, real-time fraud monitoring, 24x7 desk, 5-year logs
requirements.guidance: MFA for electronic debits unless relaxed, real-time fraud monitoring, a manned 24x7x365 desk for fraud complaints and law enforcement, audit logs kept at least five years, anti-phishing and rogue-app takedown.

requirements.title: Mobile app controls and 12-hour cooling period
requirements.guidance: Device binding and re-binding after long non-use, inactivity timeout, lockout after failed logins, block while remote-access apps run, and a 12-hour cooling period after a mobile number or email change.
